entry.title: Organized an invited session and gave a talk at EcoSta 2026.

link.title: Organized an invited session and gave a talk at EcoSta 2026.

entry.summary: I am glad to organize an invited session at EcoSta 2026. Thanks to the two speakers Professor Zheng and Professor Cui. I also gave an Invited Talk about the ‘‘Prediction Inference of Time Series with Standard ReLU Deep Neural Networks’’, which is my first independent work. Cheers!
